name: Project Fika
teaser: Project Fika is a mod designed to enable co-op multiplayer game play with your friends in SPT. You can progress through quests, share items and quest progression, fight AI bots (PMCs, SCAVs, and bosses) together and much more.

name: All Quests Checkmarks
teaser: Tired of having to remember what items you have to keep for future quests? This mod adds new checkmarks for items that are required in future quests. It also works with Fika and shows items required by your friends!

name: Project Fika - Server
teaser: Server component for the Fika mod.

name: T***** DLSS 4.5
teaser: This pre-patcher enables DLSS 4.5 support in SPT/Fika.

name: Tylevo's Tactical Service Control
teaser: Adds a TSC phone and Fika-ready Fire Support options, including UAV recon, A-10 strikes, Black Hawk extraction, stash payments, and host-controlled pricing.

name: LMSP - Let Me Switch Plates
teaser: Switch plates without removing your equipped armor / rig in raid, FIKA compatible

name: Raid Settings Skipper
teaser: Skips the raid settings screen when fika server settings are disabled.

name: Headshot Damage Redirection
teaser: Survive headshots by redirecting damage to other body parts. Fully configurable split ratios, thresholds, and RNG options. Stop getting one-tapped and fight back! Compatible with SPT 4.1.3 & FIKA

name: Extra Special Slots
teaser: Adds Special Slots 4, 5 and 6 with SVM, SpecialSlots, TSC and Fika compatibility.

name: S&M PRT - Portable Radio Transmitter
teaser: Realistic portable radio communications for EFT + FIKA with the ability to talk during a raid, with detailed interface customization and raid recordings included.

name: ShrapnelFix
teaser: Grenade fragments now fly at body height. Deadly, configurable and FIKA-ready.

name: DebugTools
teaser: The mods add an in-game database viewer that can be used whilst in raid to spawn items. It also features a debug menu that has several utilities, as well as developer commands for the console and the freecam from Fika.

name: Fika Downed Spectator
teaser: Spectate your teammates while downed in Fika with a clean, native T***** tactical HUD banner.
